title: Writability and the Pathway: A Controlled Study of Knowledge Injection into Addressed Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.21553v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Addressed conditional memory provides a local surface for post-hoc knowledge injection, but a successful write need not transfer to a new question or preserve untargeted behavior. This study combines a controlled GPT-2 comparison with production-memory experiments on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Newly initialized modules attached to frozen GPT-2 are tested in a 2 x 2 design: row-only versus row-plus-projection updates, each with or without fixed module-residual anchoring. All arms reproduce 50 trained completions in each of three sampling seeds. Natural-question target-string hits average 5.3% for both row-only arms, 28.7% for unanchored projection updates, and 22.0% with anchoring, while strict answer scores remain zero. Anchoring lowers measured drift; lexical hits do not establish entity-specific retrieval. translated_title: 可写性与通路：向寻址记忆注入知识的受控研究
translated_abstract: 寻址条件记忆为事后知识注入提供了一个局部操作面，但一次成功的写入未必能迁移到新问题上，也未必能保持非目标行为不受影响。本研究将受控的GPT-2对比实验与在Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上的生产级记忆实验相结合。附着于冻结GPT-2的新初始化模块在2×2设计中进行测试：仅行更新对比行加投影更新，每种设置分别带有或不带固定模块-残差锚定。所有实验组在三个采样种子下均能复现50个训练补全。在自然问题的目标字符串命中率方面，两个仅行更新组平均为5.3%，无锚定的投影更新为28.7%，带锚定的为22.0%，而严格答案得分始终为零。锚定降低了测得的行为漂移；词汇命中并不能确立实体特定的检索。在存档的Qwen实验中，梯度写入使指定的第一个答案token在132个（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该受控研究表明，向寻址记忆注入知识时，投影更新比仅行更新更能提高自然问题命中率（28.7%对5.3%），模块-残差锚定可降低行为漂移，但严格答案得分始终为零，说明词汇层面的命中并不等于实体特定的知识检索。
en_tdlr: This controlled study of knowledge injection into addressed memory shows that projection updates substantially outperform row-only updates on natural-question hit rates (28.7% vs 5.3%), and module-residual anchoring reduces behavioral drift, yet strict answer scores remain zero, indicating that lexical hits do not establish entity-specific retrieval.
